fields.title: 1. 8-K (2026-11-19) — What Was Disclosed
fields.md:
Source: [8-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526468549/d197844d8k.htm) (report date 2026-11-19 · signed 2026-11-19, Chief Financial Officer Charles C. Chang). There are only two items: 8.01 (Other Events) and 9.01 (Exhibits).

| Series | Principal | Coupon | Maturity year |
|---|---|---|---|
| (i) | ¥92.0 billion (¥92,000,000,000) | 2.624% | 2029 |
| (ii) | ¥57.3 billion (¥57,300,000,000) | 3.007% | 2031 |
| (iii) | ¥16.1 billion (¥16,100,000,000) | 3.313% | 2033 |
| (iv) | ¥2.7 billion (¥2,700,000,000) | 3.661% | 2036 |
| (v) | ¥14.2 billion (¥14,200,000,000) | 4.571% | 2056 |
| Total | **¥182.3 billion** (formula: 920 + 573 + 161 + 27 + 142) | Weighted 2.97% (formula) | — |

Source: the 8-K above. Terms cross-check: [FWP 2026-11-13](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526459815/d127427dfwp.htm) · [424B5 final prospectus supplement](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526465047/d86634d424b5.htm) — principal, coupon and maturity are identical for all five series.

- **Contract structure** (8-K text): issued under shelf registration statement S-3 (No. 333-284622, 2025-01-31) · underwriting agreement 2026-11-13 (Mizuho Securities USA · Merrill Lynch International) · indenture 2025-01-31 (Berkshire · Berkshire Hathaway Finance Corporation · The Bank of New York Mellon Trust Company) · five officer's certificates, one per series, and a Baker & McKenzie legal opinion (all 2026-11-19, source: [8-K exhibit list](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526468549/d197844d8k.htm)).
- **New numbers the 8-K gives**: none. The only thing newly confirmed is that the settlement that had been 'scheduled' **actually took place** (judgment). The date given as 'settlement scheduled 2026-11-19' in the previous two installments was correct (cross-check: [424B5](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526465047/d86634d424b5.htm) scheduled settlement date ↔ [8-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526468549/d197844d8k.htm) issue date).
- **What the 8-K does not give**: the redemption of the notes to be refinanced — ¥73.4 billion (0.955%, maturing 2026-11-27) and ¥23.0 billion (0.203%, maturing 2027-01-25). The use of proceeds is stated in the 424B5 (source: [424B5](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526465047/d86634d424b5.htm)), and redemption is to be confirmed after the maturity dates, in the 4Q26 10-K debt footnote.

### How large this issuance is relative to Berkshire's numbers (rough)
- Dollar conversion: ¥182.3 billion ÷ 159.97 ≈ **$1.14 billion** (estimate — the yen/dollar rate is 159.97, ECB as of 2026-11-19 per data/fx_lens.json). Net increase excluding the refinanced portion: ¥85.9 billion (formula 1,823 − 964) ≈ $0.54 billion (estimate, same rate — the ¥96.4 billion of refinanced notes is from the [424B5](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526465047/d86634d424b5.htm)).
- Annual interest cost: new notes about ¥5.42 billion (formula Σ principal × coupon = 24.14 + 17.23 + 5.33 + 0.99 + 6.49) vs refinanced notes about ¥0.75 billion (formula 734 × 0.955% + 230 × 0.203%) → difference about ¥4.67 billion ≈ $29 million per year (pre-tax, estimate — same rate. Principal and coupons from the [8-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526468549/d197844d8k.htm) and [424B5](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526465047/d86634d424b5.htm)).
- Comparison: about 0.2% (formula 29 ÷ 12,705, ignoring the pre-tax/after-tax difference) of 3Q26 one-quarter after-tax operating earnings of $12.705 billion (source: [8-K EX-99.1](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526452530/brka-ex99_1.htm)) — the size that reaches the earnings engine is small (judgment). Against the headline cash of $377.4 billion, the net increase of $0.54 billion is about 0.1% (formula 5.4 ÷ 3,774).
- Interpretation (judgment): it is common to explain yen-denominated notes as a pairing with the currency exposure of the Japanese trading-house stakes (yen assets), but the 8-K and 424B5 this probe read do not state such a purpose (the 424B5 use-of-proceeds section explicitly names refinancing) — a hedging purpose could not be confirmed from the original text. That coupons are about 2 percentage points higher than the previous generation (0.2–1.0%) is an observation showing a change in the Japanese interest rate level (formula 2.97% − 0.955%, source: [424B5](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526465047/d86634d424b5.htm)).
